entries.name: forgelm-token-streaming-v070
entries.definition: ForgeLM.generate emits callbacks from the actual local sampling loop. The Python text and multimodal runtimes serialize cumulative decoded text as newline-delimited token events, the Node bridge parses and forwards those events through the local model router and OneChat session journal, and the browser progressively renders them over replayable SSE. Stop uses the same AbortSignal to terminate the local ForgeLM subprocess. Token streaming is only claimed for ForgeLM paths that emit these generation-time events.

entries.name: onechat-durable-session-recovery-v071
entries.definition: Live OneChat sessions persist an atomic state snapshot plus append-only JSONL event journal under state/onechat-turn-sessions. The owner may explicitly resume an interrupted turn as a new linked session. Browser sessionStorage reconnects to surviving live sessions and exposes explicit interrupted-session resume.
